Registers a new connector in our platform. The account name informed in the request should be the one owned by the partner since it is the only account that will have permission to update or delete the connector.

Possible values for field `type`:

- `APP`, if using our App Template.
- `EXTERNAL`, if not using App Template.

Possible values for field `segment`:

- `APPAREL_ACCESSORIES`

items.docs:
This endpoint can be triggered by marketplaces to simulate the fulfillment of an item in the cart.

The fulfillment information is useful whenever you need to know the availability of fulfilling an order for a specific cart setting, since the API response will let you know the updated price, inventory and shipping data.
